Definition: to expose or remove the prepuce, whether literal (to go naked) or figurative (to refrain from using)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to remain uncircumcised, count uncircumcised, count as foreskin; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to regard as uncircumcised; 1a2) to remain unharvested (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to be counted as uncircumcised
